Report: Abbas announces dissolution of Palestinian unity government
I'm not very savvy with Palestinian politics. Does anyone know how important this move is? Any impacts?

Not really, more like the end of something that was trying to make an impact. There are two competing factions within Palestine, Fatah and Hamas, who both wish to form a Palestinian state and become that state's government. Part of Israel's reasoning (rhetoric) behind controlling Palestine is this inability to form a unified government. Hamas (1988) is listed as a terrorist organization by the United States and Israel and has the stated goal of liberating Palestine through it's military wing. Fatah is a popular secular political party of the PLO (Palestinian Liberation Organization, 1964) which has been the de facto governing body in Palestine for a long time. The PLO is recognized by over 100 countries and has observer status at the UN. The Palestinian Unity Government (2014) is less than a year old and was an attempt to reconcile Hamas and Fatah under Abbas (who was president of the PLO since 2004). Since then Hamas has used this unification to try and increase their influence and weaken other parties in the PLO.

edit: disclaimer: this conflict is complex, it has a lot of moving parts and shifting allegiances, no two people will tell you the same thing
